svg.title: Terraform plan
svg.desc: 10 resources (4 spatial cards, 6 logical resources in 6 group cards) · 12 relationships Thin solid: dependency. Dashed: association. Thick dotted: connection. Nested boxes: containment. Edge color preserves the Terraform action when available. Service label backgrounds: orange = compute; green = storage; blue = network; red = IAM; gray = unclassified.

g.text: 10 resources (4 spatial cards, 6 logical resources in 6 group cards) · 12 relationships

Hollow circles mark resource/card attachment points; neither end of an undirected line is a directional start.
Filled internal dots mark bundle junctions.
Matching [N] badges identify the same Terraform-backed relationship and its Relationship Resources entry. They do
not express direction or count connections. Reference-only Connections and Dependencies have no number.
